7121.title: Terminal pool refresh errors on current main
7121.rootCauseOneLine: The 0.48.1 release only recorded usage-refresh errors for an already-errored account; main repairs the transition and suppresses rejected-token replays.
7121.proposedFix: No new patch: verify deployment includes the November 2 repair in 6e77fce8c7; both clean current-main probes and all 390 plugin tests pass.
7121.caveats: The actual deployed bundle and provider token rotation were not inspected. The older release was examined statically, not executed. Both clean runs were performed by the same investigator.
